For questions please use the VirBiCoin [Discord](https://discord.virbicoin.com); issues are for bugs and feature requests. Please do not report security vulnerabilities in a public issue (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/virbicoin/open-virbicoin/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)).

_Before filing a new issue, please **provide the following information**._

- **ovbc version** (output of `ovbc --version`): Ovbc/vX.Y.Z-stable/linux-amd64/rustc1.75.0
- **Operating system and architecture**: Linux / macOS / Windows, x86_64 / arm64
- **Installation**: release binary / built from source
- **Fully synchronized**: no / yes
- **Restarted**: no / yes

_Your issue description goes here below. Try to include **actual** vs. **expected behavior** and **steps to reproduce** the issue._
